items.title: 3 Restaurant Stocks with Questionable Fundamentals
items.summary: Restaurants are go-to meeting hubs for friends, family, and colleagues. But it’s not all sunshine and rainbows as they’re notoriously hard to run thanks to perishable ingredients, labor shortages, or volatile consumer spending. These factors have weighed on the industry over the past six months as its 4.4% return has fallen short of the S&P 500’s 13.1% gain.

items.title: Starbucks Plans About $1 Billion of North American Cafe Upgrades, FT Reports
items.summary: Starbucks (NASDAQ:SBUX) plans to invest about $1 billion in upgrades to its North American cafes as part of changes intended to encourage customers to spend more time in its stores, according to a Financial Times report. The coffee chain is planning renovations across as many as 9,000 company-operated locations in North America, the FT reported, citing Dawn Clark, Starbucks’ senior vice-president of coffee house design and concepts.
